description: Type the domain-ownership-required 422 on createServiceDomain and createWorkspaceDomainOwnership, and the 400 a domain create returns before the hostname's CNAME resolves. The spec declares a single 422 for two failures (no promoted deployment / not a valid domain, and a missing ownership TXT record), so the ownership case lands in the generic UnprocessableEntity and its `error.verification` record is lost. Observed live on 2026-10-29: POST /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/domain-ownerships for a hostname with no TXT record returns 422 {"error":{"code":"domain-ownership-required","message":...,"hint":...,"verification":{"type":"TXT","name":"_prisma-verification.<hostname>","value":"prisma-verification=<token>","ttl":300}}}; POST /v1/apps/{appId}/domains returns the same body. The CNAME rejection is a 400 whose text contains "DNS is not configured" (matched on the whole body by alchemy's Prisma.CustomDomain since #1888, 2026-10-23); the matchers check `message` and `error.hint`.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The workspace has not proved it owns the domain. `body.error.verification` holds the TXT record (`type`, `name`, `value`, `ttl`) to publish before retrying.
The hostname's CNAME to the app's switchboard does not resolve yet. Publish it (or wait for it to propagate) and retry.
